nodes.summary: Stand up the Python project tree, environment, pytest runner, and bin/test.sh.
nodes.instructions:
Create the Python 3.11 project root: pyproject.toml, committed uv.lock, .venv via uv venv,
tests/ with conftest.py exposing the db_session and cli_runner fixtures, and a POSIX sh
bin/test.sh that activates the environment, runs pytest -q from the application root, and
exits zero only when every test passes.

Document in ARCHITECTURE.md the module ownership: only the shipped persistence package touches
a database driver, and money is integer cents at every layer.

nodes.summary: Provide the ledger executable, command dispatch, exit codes, CSV output, and input validators.
nodes.instructions:
Create the executable ./ledger at the application root, cli.main(argv) -> int, and dispatch
with usage errors (unknown command, table, report, wrong argument count) exiting 2.
Provide shared helpers: a typed error mapping to exits 1, 3, and 4, diagnostics on stderr
only, CSV row writer ("\n" endings, no quoting), validators for codes, names, memos, dates,
and amounts, integer-cent parsing and two-decimal formatting with no floating point, and the
transaction row formatter. Open the database through open_database with DATABASE_URL, then
DATABASE_PATH, then data/app.db.
nodes.name: Provide the ledger executable, command dispatch, exit codes, CSV output, and input validators.

nodes.instructions:
Provide account_summary(code) returning transaction count and balance computed from stored
rows, and a check that takes a proposed set of added, changed, or removed transactions and
rejects (exit 3) when any account balance would fall below zero. Compute balances from stored
rows in integer cents; nothing is hardcoded.

nothing to stdout, exit 0. Rerunning leaves an empty ledger. Issue no DDL.
nodes.name: Implement ledger init to reset the ledger to empty.

row exits 3 with nothing stored. Print table,loaded and categories,<rows>.

against stored rows) before the first write; any invalid row exits 3 with nothing stored.
Print table,loaded and accounts,<rows>. An unreadable file exits 1.
nodes.name: Implement ledger load accounts with all-or-nothing validation.
